trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Request to only check eligibility without scheduling pickup yet.

steps.purpose: Explain eligibility and ask for pickup preference.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ order return ಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ನಿಮಗೆ 7 days return window ಇದೆ. Route refund ಅಂತ ಬಂದಿದೆ. ಅಂದ್ರೆ ದುಡ್ಡು ವಾಪಸ್ ಬರುತ್ತೆ. ಈಗ ನಾಳೆಗೆ pickup schedule ಮಾಡ್ಲಾ?

ಹೌದು, ನಾಳೆ pickup ಗೆ schedule ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
ನಿಮ್ಮ pickup schedule ಆಗಿದೆ. ನಾಳೆ eKart courier ಅವರು ಬಂದು pick up ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ. Pickup ID ಬಂದು PKP-8821.

steps.purpose: Repeat details to confirm and ask about refund.
steps.text: Pickup ID PKP-8821. ಸರಿ. ನಾಳೆ ಬರ್ತಾರೆ ಅಲ್ವಾ? ಮತ್ತೆ refund ಯಾವಾಗ ಬರುತ್ತೆ?
ಹೌದು, ನಾಳೆ ಬರ್ತಾರೆ. Pickup ಕಂಪ್ಲೀಟ್ ಆದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ನಿಮ್ಮ refund process ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. Exact refund timeline ಅವಾಗಲೇ generate ಆಗೋದು, ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ನಾನು ಈಗಲೇ ಇಷ್ಟು ದಿನ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳೋಕೆ ಆಗಲ್ಲ.
ಸರಿ, pickup ಆದ ಮೇಲೆ refund timeline ಗೊತ್ತಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ಅರ್ಥ ಆಯ್ತು. ಬೇರೆ ಏನು ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕಾ ನಾನು?
ನೀವು ಏನೂ ಮಾಡಬೇಕಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. Item ಅನ್ನ box ಅಲ್ಲಿ pack ಮಾಡಿ ಇಡಿ ಅಷ್ಟೇ. ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು.

ir.terminal_condition: Pickup scheduled and the refund route and timeline stated from the results.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The workflow's business rules enforce a strict linear sequence of tools (verify identity -> check eligibility -> schedule pickup). There is no decision point where multiple tools are plausibly applicable and the customer's stated goal singles one out.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Selection > Correct Tool Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly grounds the 7-day window, eKart courier, and PKP-8821 pickup ID entirely in the tool results. They also adhere to the rule that the refund follows pickup without making unsupported forward guarantees about the exact timeline, which the tool did not provide.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The persona constraint 'Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words' is completely missing. The user expresses confusion about navigating the app, but does not misread or ask for clarification on any domain terminology.
issues.repair_instruction: Revise the user's dialogue starting at e5 to misread a domain term (e.g., misunderstanding 'return window' or 'eligibility' from the app) and ask the agent to explain it in simple words, before proceeding with the identity verification.

issues.detail: The terminal condition requires stating the refund timeline from the results. However, the timeline (`credit_days`) is only returned by `issue_refund`, which is consequential and cannot be called before the pickup occurs (per BR_RT_04). Thus, the agent cannot state the timeline without violating business rules.
issues.repair_instruction: Have the agent explicitly explain to the customer that the exact refund timeline will be generated and communicated once the pickup is completed, fulfilling the spirit of the condition without hallucinating a timeline or improperly calling the refund tool.

verification.summary: The conversation correctly follows the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH script mode and adheres to the business rules by scheduling the pickup before addressing the refund. However, it fails to realize the persona constraint regarding misreading domain terminology. Additionally, the terminal condition requiring the agent to state the refund timeline is logically impossible in this scenario, as the timeline is only accessible via a consequential tool that cannot be executed prior to the item's pickup. The Correct Tool Selection variant is unrealized due to the strict sequential nature of the required tools.

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly selects check_return_eligibility before scheduling a pickup or discussing refunds, navigating multiple available tools based on the user's goal and business rules.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Selection > Correct Tool Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent successfully grounds the window days, courier, and pickup ID in the tool outputs, but violates the negative constraint by making absolute forward guarantees about the refund happening after the call ends.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The agent makes forward guarantees about the refund happening after the call ('ಆಮೇಲೆ refund ಆಗುತ್ತೆ' in e12, 'ನಿಮ್ಮ refund process ಆಗುತ್ತೆ' in e19), violating the Tool Output Grounding requirement to not guarantee what happens after the call ends.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite from e12 to frame the refund as an eligibility or conditional step upon successful pickup (e.g., 'Pickup ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾದರೆ refund ಗೆ eligible ಆಗ್ತೀರಾ'), avoiding absolute guarantees that the refund will definitively happen.

verification.summary: The conversation is well-structured and follows the persona and business rules perfectly. However, the agent violates the Tool Output Grounding constraint by making absolute forward guarantees about the refund processing after the call ends. A suffix repair from e12 is needed to soften these guarantees into statements of eligibility based on the tool's output.

variant_findings.reason: There is no decision point where multiple tools are plausibly applicable and the user's stated goal singles one out. The tools used (verify_customer_identity, check_return_eligibility, schedule_pickup) are used sequentially without any ambiguity that requires resolution.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Selection > Correct Tool Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds all stated figures and statuses (7 days, refund route, eKart, PKP-8821) in the tool results. Furthermore, the agent correctly refuses to provide a specific refund timeline since it was not returned by the eligibility tool, safely stating instead that the exact timeline will be communicated after the pickup.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: Under the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH script mode, English words must be written in the Roman alphabet. The conversation contains English words written in Kannada script, such as 'ಆರ್ಡರ್' (order) in e3, 'ಚೆಕ್' (check) in e8, and 'ಕಂಪ್ಲೀಟ್' (complete) in e19.
issues.repair_instruction: Replace 'ಆರ್ಡರ್' with 'order' in e3, 'ಚೆಕ್' with 'check' in e8, and 'ಕಂಪ್ಲೀಟ್' with 'complete' in e19.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates Tool Output Grounding, accurately handling a missing timeline without hallucinating, and strictly adheres to the business rules and persona requirements. However, it fails to realize Correct Tool Selection as there is no ambiguity between tools at any decision point. Additionally, there are surface-level script mode violations where English words are written in Kannada script rather than Roman.

variant_findings.reason: The user asks to check if a second order can be returned. The agent correctly selects check_return_eligibility from multiple available tools to fulfill this stated goal.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Selection > Correct Tool Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent makes an unsupported forward guarantee in e19 by stating the customer will receive a message with the exact refund timeline, which is not provided by any tool output and violates the variant requirements.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e19, the agent guarantees that the customer will receive a message with the exact refund timeline after the pickup is completed. This violates the Tool Output Grounding requirement which forbids guarantees about what happens after the call ends, as the tools and policy do not support this claim.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite e19 to state that the refund will be processed after the pickup is completed, without promising a message or exact timeline generation.

verification.summary: The conversation is well-structured and follows the persona and business rules effectively. However, it fails the Tool Output Grounding variant because the agent hallucinates a post-call event (sending a message with the refund timeline) in e19. A surface repair can fix this issue without affecting the rest of the dialogue.

variant_findings.reason: The agent presents two valid options (scheduling pickup or checking eligibility). The user explicitly asks to only check eligibility, and the agent correctly selects the check_return_eligibility tool instead of schedule_pickup.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Selection > Correct Tool Selection

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds its responses in the tool outputs (e.g., stating the 7-day window, refund route, eKart courier, and PKP-8821). Furthermore, when asked about the refund timeline, the agent correctly refuses to provide an unsupported forward guarantee since the tool did not return a timeline.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants. The agent correctly sets up a decision point for tool selection and respects the user's choice. It also strictly grounds its responses in the tool outputs, explicitly refusing to hallucinate a refund timeline that wasn't provided. The persona traits are well-portrayed, and the language accurately reflects the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH script mode without any logical or policy violations.
